scope: Evaluator-only authored ordinary reference baseline from the stipulated synthetic case. This incomplete archive is neither empirical evidence nor a recommended correct solution. Absence from it supports no global novelty inference.

families.plain_description: Use timed speaking turns within pairs.
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer gives partners equal timed turns and clear roles for asking, answering, and following up.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Protected turns can reduce speaking imbalance and increase practice time for quieter participants.
families.conditions: Keep the conversational purpose and fit the 75-minute room booking.
families.assumptions: Participants find the prompts useful and accept a simple turn structure.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer pairs people using private or voluntary preferences and permits an easy partner change after the first prompt.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Quicker matching reduces formation time and helps occasional attendees enter suitable conversations.
families.conditions: No required public proficiency label and no exclusion for prior absence.
families.assumptions: Preferences can be gathered quickly without creating excessive coordination work.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Issue one dated preparation card with a closing recap.
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer gives each attendee a printed next-session task and repeats its date and instructions before departure.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Consistent dated information reduces confusion between earlier and current preparation tasks.
families.conditions: Printed access remains sufficient and tasks support conversation.
families.assumptions: Participants retain the card or know where to obtain a replacement.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Reuse a small library of self-contained topic packs.
families.actor_operation_target: Alternating volunteers select a ready topic pack containing entry prompts and optional extensions.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Reusable preparation reduces volunteer effort while self-contained entry prompts support irregular attendance.
families.conditions: Participation remains free and suitable conversational challenge is preserved.
families.assumptions: Existing sheets can be adapted cheaply and the pack range serves participant needs.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: What do participants count as useful speaking practice?
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteers collect anonymous examples and observe approximate speaking time and turn balance within pairs.
families.causal_path_or_observable: These observations distinguish low speaking opportunity from practice that feels unsuitable despite sufficient time.
families.conditions: No compulsory proficiency disclosure or individual tracking is required.
families.assumptions: Anonymous responses and observation provide a reasonable view of current experience.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Which information and coordination steps cause confusion and extra work?
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteers time weekly preparation activities and ask attendees which dated task information they received.
families.causal_path_or_observable: The comparison can locate repeated inquiries, stale messages, or unclear instructions.
families.conditions: Include printed-information users and keep data collection brief.
families.assumptions: Participants can recall the source of their preparation instructions.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs
